description: Defines the SupplierQuotationController class for handling supplier quotation forms in ERPNext, including setup, refresh, and button actions, as well as related utility functions.

classes.name: SupplierQuotationController
classes.description: Controller class for supplier quotation form handling, extending erpnext.buying.BuyingController.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes custom buttons for the form.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Updates form UI based on document status, adds custom buttons for actions like creating purchase orders, quotations, and linking to material requests.

methods.name: make_purchase_order
methods.description: Creates a purchase order from the current supplier quotation.

methods.name: make_quotation
methods.description: Creates a quotation from the current supplier quotation.
